access.title: GitHub access

tierDesc.gh: Seelegent uses the signed-in GitHub CLI (gh) to read issues, open pull requests and read checks.
tierDesc.token: Seelegent uses the stored token to read issues, open pull requests and read checks.
tierDesc.manual: No GitHub sign-in: Seelegent pushes branches and gives you a link to open each pull request yourself.

access.stored: A token ending in {hint} is stored.
access.tokenHint: Sent once and never shown again. It is used only for the hosts above.
access.removeDesc: Seelegent falls back to the GitHub CLI, or to manual pull requests.

connect.title: Connect a repository
connect.desc: A Git repository on this computer. Its issues come from GitHub when its origin is on a GitHub host.
connect.pathHint: The absolute path of the repository folder.
connect.initDesc: Run git init there first if the folder is not a repository yet.

repo.label: Repository
repo.emptyDesc: Connect a repository to see its issues and turn them into tickets.
repo.counts: {inbox} in the inbox · {working} working · {waitingPr} waiting for a PR · {sent} sent · {skipped} skipped
repo.disconnectDesc: Seelegent forgets this repository and its inbox. The folder, its branches and its worktrees stay as they are.

inbox.emptyDesc: Sync to fetch the repository's issues from GitHub, or add a local issue.

add.title: Add a local issue
add.desc: A local issue stays on this computer; it never reaches GitHub.

triage.title: Decide {key}

actionDesc.assign: Make a ticket: its own branch and worktree, and a task for a worker.
actionDesc.meeting: Open a meeting about the issue in a new ticket's worktree.
actionDesc.skip: Leave the issue; the reason is kept.

triage.promptHint: Your brief for the worker. The issue text is added as untrusted data.
triage.modelHint: Empty: the member's or the backend's default.
triage.question: Question
triage.noMembers: No team members yet. Add some on the Members page.
triage.reasonError: Enter why the issue is skipped.

tickets.emptyDesc: Assign an issue from the inbox to make a ticket.

ticket.noFiles: No changes against the base yet.
ticket.outboxRefused: Seelegent refused this step: why, and what to do, is at the top of the page.

desc.pr: Commits the worktree, pushes the ticket's branch and opens a pull request. Secrets, keys and junk files stop it.
desc.link: Record a pull request you opened by hand for this branch.
desc.task: Another task in this ticket's worktree.
desc.comment: Posts a comment on the GitHub issue.
desc.drop: Stops the ticket and cancels its running tasks. The worktree stays until you remove it.
desc.retry: Starts the ticket's task again in its worktree. Pick another member or backend to reassign it.

actions.prBodyHint: Empty: a summary that links the issue.
actions.numberError: Enter the pull request's number or its address (…/pull/43).
actions.retryPromptHint: Empty: the worker works on the issue as written.
actions.backendHint: Another backend uses its own accounts.
actions.numberHint: The number, or the pull request's address.
actions.retryPickOther: Pick another member or a backend.
actions.retryNoMembers: There are no other members to pick. Choose a backend.
actions.retryNoMembersSame: There are no other members to pick: it runs as before, or on the backend you choose.

title.secrets: Not pushed: {count} file looks like it contains a secret | Not pushed: {count} files look like they contain secrets
title.files: Not pushed: {count} file cannot go to GitHub | Not pushed: {count} files cannot go to GitHub
title.scanChanged: Not pushed: the worktree changed during the check
title.scanFailed: Not pushed: the changes could not be checked
title.baseNotPushed: Not pushed: {branch} has {commits} commit that is not on GitHub | Not pushed: {branch} has {commits} commits that are not on GitHub
title.baseMissing: Not pushed: the base branch {branch} is not on GitHub
title.branchDiverged: Push blocked: the branch {branch} changed on GitHub

why.unsafeFiles: Nothing was committed or pushed. Each file below says what to do.
why.scanChanged: Seelegent checks exactly what it pushes; a worker or you changed files while it read them, so nothing was sent.
why.scanFailed: Git failed while Seelegent read the changes, and nothing is ever pushed unchecked.
why.baseNotPushed: That commit would go to GitHub with the ticket's, unchecked. | Those commits would go to GitHub with the ticket's, unchecked.
why.branchDiverged: Someone pushed to {branch} or changed it on GitHub. Seelegent never builds on such a branch or overwrites it.

next.scanChanged: Wait until the ticket's task has stopped, then try again.
next.scanFailed: Try again. If it keeps failing, check the worktree with git status.
next.baseNotPushed: Push {branch} to GitHub, then try again.
next.branchDiverged: Look at the commits Seelegent did not push, undo them on GitHub, then try again; or drop this ticket.

refusal.moreCommits: and {count} more commit | and {count} more commits

openPr.title: Branch pushed: open the pull request on GitHub
openPr.why: No pull request exists yet: Seelegent has no GitHub sign-in to open it. Open it with the link, then record its number with Link PR.

checks.title: {count} check failed on the pull request | {count} checks failed on the pull request
checks.why: The pull request's CI checks failed.

review.title: A task is waiting for your review
review.why: Accept the task to make the ticket ready for a pull request, or reject it to send it back.

ready.title: Ready for a pull request
ready.why: The task was accepted. Nothing is pushed until you or the lead ask: no access tier opens pull requests on its own.

failed.title: The ticket's task could not start
failed.why: Start it again, with the same worker or another member or backend.
failed.memberMissing: The member "{member}" no longer exists. Assign the task to another member or a backend.
failed.memberDisabled: The member "{member}" is turned off. Turn it on on the Members page, or assign the task to another member or a backend.

exposed.title: Already public: {count} file that looks like a secret was pushed by the earlier version | Already public: {count} files that look like secrets were pushed by the earlier version
exposed.why: The branch on GitHub holds the worker's own commits from before this version, and these files are in them. Seelegent builds on the branch and pushes nothing new of them.
exposed.next: Rotate every key these files held: deleting them now does not take them back from GitHub.

kind.link: A link to a place outside the worktree

secret.stored_token: Holds the GitHub token stored in Seelegent

fix.file: Delete it, or add it to .gitignore.
fix.secret: Take the key out of the code (read it from the environment instead), and rotate it if it was ever shared.
fix.large: Remove it, or add it to .gitignore if it is build output.
fix.device: Delete it: Windows cannot check out a file with this name.
fix.link: Delete the link, or copy what it points to into the worktree.

cause.gitAuth: Git could not sign in to the remote. Set up git credentials for it (for GitHub: gh auth setup-git), or check the token, then try again.
cause.gitRejected: The remote refused the push (a protected branch or a server-side rule).
cause.network: GitHub or the remote could not be reached in time. Check the connection and try again.
cause.githubAuth: GitHub refused the sign-in. Sign in to gh again or replace the token.
cause.githubRateLimited: GitHub's rate limit was reached. Try again later.
cause.githubForbidden: The GitHub account or token may not do this on this repository.
cause.githubManual: This step needs the gh CLI signed in or a GitHub token.
